note: Append-only elevation ledger. ONE JSON object per line, never edited, never reordered. The execution session appends; the strategy session reads. Events: handoff|started|completed|blocked|verified|reverted. Required: ts (ISO8601 w/ offset), asset (ka_* id or _schema), event, session. Optional: commit (sha), branch, evidence (path or URL), brief_version, note. A 'completed' with no matching 'verified' is NOT elevated — the strategy session verifies.
